[size=3]Chinese (thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/104142703]Awassakura[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/158984893]huangmiu[/url]), English, French, Korean (thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/189989571]asas84562[/url]) and Portuguese (thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/200703680]NARCOAZAZAL[/url]) translations are included in the base mod, and contributions are welcome. To contribute, please submit a pull request on the [url=https://github.com/mouahrara/QOLEssentials/pulls]GitHub repository[/url].[/size]

[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wiki/mouahrara/QOLEssentials/images/scrolls/04.png[/img]

[size=3]QOL Essentials is compatible with Stardew Valley 1.6.0+ on Linux/Mac/Windows/Android, both single-player and multiplayer.[/size]
